If sentiment is >0.5 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is <0.3 and forecast is falling, increase early-period forecast by 1.0–1.5% to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment spikes to 1.0 after a 3-day downtrend, shift mid-period forecast upward by 1.0–2.0% to reflect momentum reversal.  
If sentiment is flat (0.0–0.3) across 5+ days, suppress forecast volatility in late period by smoothing deviations under 0.5% from prior day.  
If forecast shows a sharp upward spike in mid-period with low sentiment, cap the peak at 1.5% above prior high to prevent overcorrection.  
If sentiment is >0.6 and forecast is flat, initiate a 0.5–1.0% downward adjustment in late period to avoid sentiment-driven inflation.
